products.name: Whirlpool Intellifresh Pro 235 L convertible double-door refrigerator, Illusia Steel
products.summary: Open the freezer and the fridge one at a time, slide out the trays, then stand it in your kitchen at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap a door to open it
products.sizeNote: Whirlpool gives 56.4 × 158.7 × 65.5 cm (W × H × D) and publishes no door swing or clearances
specs: 10-in-1: All Season, Grocery Day, Beverages, Deep Freeze, Energy Saver, Fast Ice, Party, Vacation, Chef, Mini Ref
IntelliSense inverter, auto-connects to a home inverter
External touch panel on the freezer door
Toughened glass: 4 in the fridge, 1 in the freezer
4 fridge door pockets, 2 freezer door pockets, egg tray
Vegetable and fruit drawer, ice bank
1 year comprehensive, 10 years on the compressor

hotspots.title: Convertible 10-in-1 Modes
hotspots.text: Now convert your refrigerator at the touch of a button with 10-in-1 convertible modes.

hotspots.title: Convert freezer to fridge in 10 min
hotspots.text: Now convert your freezer to fridge according to your needs in the fastest time of 10 mins.

hotspots.title: Up to 240 kg weight bearing capacity
hotspots.text: The toughened glass end to end shelves can bear up to 240kg of load, allowing you to keep large pots and utensils inside without any fear of breakage.

hotspots.title: Up to 15 days of extended freshness in both fridge and freezer
hotspots.text: Get up to 15 days of extended freshness in the fridge and freezer both. Now store vegetables in your freezer as well, without worrying about spoilage.
